title: DeepSeek to Build 8T-Parameter AI Model Using Huawei Hardware
summary:
The developer of the V5 artificial intelligence model will leverage Huawei Ascend chips for the project's pretraining phase. DeepSeek intends to build a model with 8T parameters, a scale that has reportedly outgrown the capacity of the Nvidia clusters the firm can currently construct for its hardware roadmap.

The shift to domestic Chinese hardware involves the use of Huawei's neural processing units, including the Ascend 960DT chip which is projected for availability in the first quarter of 2027. The move marks a significant change in infrastructure for the company as it scales its next-generation large language model.
